definitions.explanation: The act of a ship leaving a harbor or port. Used in maritime, travel, and news contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出港|しゅっこう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{出港|しゅっこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{延期|えんき}→延期：01888_enki⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The departure was postponed due to the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦フェリー→フェリー：11168_ferii⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧8⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{横浜港|よこはまこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{出港|しゅっこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The ferry departs from Yokohama Port every morning at 8 o'clock.

notes:
The act of a ship leaving port. Used as both a noun and a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb.

FORMS:
{出|しゅつ} (exit/leave) + {港|こう} (port/harbor)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出港|しゅっこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to depart from port
- {出港|しゅっこう}⟦{時刻|じこく}→時刻：03270_jikoku⟧: departure time
- {出港|しゅっこう}⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧: departure procedures
- {出港|しゅっこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見送|みおく}る→見送る：04240_miokuru⟧: to see a ship off

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{入港|にゅうこう}→入港：14771_nyuukou⟧: entering port (opposite)
- ⟦{出航|しゅっこう}→出航：30231_shukkou⟧: setting sail (same reading, broader — can include aircraft or general departure)

Note the homophone ⟦{出航|しゅっこう}→出航：30231_shukkou⟧: {出港|しゅっこう} specifically means leaving a port, while ⟦{出航|しゅっこう}→出航：30231_shukkou⟧ means beginning a voyage and can apply more broadly.
